description: Figures one household's 2026 state income tax in all 50 states and DC from its income (Social Security, IRA and 401(k) withdrawals, a private or government pension, military retirement pay, wages, interest, dividends, long-term gains) and returns every jurisdiction ranked from the lowest tax to the highest, with each state's tax, its share of total income and, given current_state, the difference from the state the household lives in now; the federal tax, which is the same in every state; the lowest and highest states and how many charge $0; the county taxes included; and every default assumed and what is not modelled. Computed by QuantCalc's federal and state tax APIs (POST /api/state-tax/every-state), the engines the website's 'Your retirement tax in every state' page is checked against to the cent. Requires a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass; without one it returns no figures and names the free web page. Not tax advice.

age.description: The age the filer reaches in 2026 (18-110).

current_state.description: Optional: two-letter code of the state the household lives in now (or DC). Adds each state's difference from it and its rank.

filing_status.description: 2026 filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

ira_distributions.description: Taxable 2026 IRA, 401(k) and 403(b) withdrawals, the household's total. Default 0.

long_term_gains.description: 2026 net long-term capital gain (0 or more). Default 0.

military_pension.description: Taxable 2026 military retirement pay, the household's total (not in pension). Federally a taxable pension; each state applies its own military retirement rule (exempt, capped, age-tested or credited). On a joint return it follows spouse_split like the pension. Default 0.

ordinary_dividends.description: Ordinary dividends (Form 1099-DIV box 1a), including the qualified part. Default 0.

pension.description: Taxable 2026 pension and annuity income, the household's total. Default 0.

pension_type.description: Whether the pension is a private pension or a government (federal, state or local) pension, which many states tax differently. Default private, stated in the result when a pension is given.

qualified_dividends.description: The qualified part of ordinary_dividends; not more than ordinary_dividends. Default 0.

social_security.description: Gross 2026 Social Security benefits of the household; the engine figures the taxable part. Default 0.

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the age the spouse reaches in 2026. Default: the same as age, stated in the result.

spouse_split.description: Joint return only: whose the IRA withdrawals, pension and wages are on the state return: even (half each), filer or spouse. Arkansas, Delaware, Maryland, Minnesota, Missouri, North Dakota, Ohio and Virginia tax a couple by each spouse's own income, so there it can change the state tax; federal tax does not depend on it. Default even, stated in the result.

name: state_tax_in_every_state
title: 2026 state income tax in every state, ranked
